newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures down on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures down on technical selling.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday on technical-driven selling by private investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen to 1.9 yen per kg lower. Most-active benchmark August was off 1.9 yen at 154.4 yen.
The market started the day lower across the board. "The yen's firmer tendency against the dollar stimulated technical selling," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
Activity was sluggish. "Interest in rubber futures continued to be thin as investors are putting money into more volatile commodity futures," he said.
